tool_arguments.sql:
WITH losses AS (
  SELECT Team_1 AS Team_Id
  FROM Match
  WHERE Team_1 <> Match_Winner
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Team_2 AS Team_Id
  FROM Match
  WHERE Team_2 <> Match_Winner
), loss_counts AS (
  SELECT Team_Id, COUNT(*) AS losses
  FROM losses
  GROUP BY Team_Id
)

FROM loss_counts lc
JOIN Team t ON t.Team_Id = lc.Team_Id
WHERE lc.losses = (SELECT MAX(losses) FROM loss_counts)
ORDER BY t.Team_Name;

WITH country_counts AS (
  SELECT c.Country_Name, COUNT(*) AS player_count
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Bowling_Style b ON p.Bowling_skill = b.Bowling_Id
  JOIN Country c ON p.Country_Name = c.Country_Id
  WHERE b.Bowling_skill = 'Slow left-arm chinaman'
  GROUP BY c.Country_Name
)
SELECT Country_Name
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_count = (SELECT MAX(player_count) FROM country_counts);
